activity_event_identity_check.name: activity_event_identity_check
activity_event_identity_check.value: length("activity_event"."activity_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND length("activity_event"."action_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length("activity_event"."category") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "activity_event"."schema_version" > 0

activity_event_values_check.name: activity_event_values_check
activity_event_values_check.value: ("activity_event"."before_value" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("activity_event"."before_value") = 'object' AND octet_length("activity_event"."before_value"::text) <= 65536)) AND ("activity_event"."after_value" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("activity_event"."after_value") = 'object' AND octet_length("activity_event"."after_value"::text) <= 65536)) AND ("activity_event"."metadata" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("activity_event"."metadata") = 'object' AND octet_length("activity_event"."metadata"::text) <= 65536))

activity_event_target_check.name: activity_event_target_check
activity_event_target_check.value: "activity_event"."target" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("activity_event"."target") = 'object' AND "activity_event"."target" ? 'routeKey' AND jsonb_typeof("activity_event"."target"->'routeKey') = 'string' AND length("activity_event"."target"->>'routeKey') BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND octet_length("activity_event"."target"::text) <= 4096)
